r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.headline_definition: (1/Q) * sum_q r_q / min(K, R_q)  over days q where R_q > 0; K in {1, 3, 5, 10, 20}
r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.relationship_to_legacy_fields: The *_r_precision_* keys below (and any 'weighted_r_precision' fields) record the pre-2026-06-01 weighted R-precision (per-day variable K = R(d), micro-aggregated). That is a different metric — not a special case of R-Precision@K. See `.claude/memories/project-r-precision-methodology.md`.
r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.canonical_r_precision_at_k_csv: results/gbdt/data/r_precision_at_k.csv  (per-cell rows × K in {1,3,5,10,20}, plus AUC + base_rate)

title: nifty500 +30% / 50d / dd15% — H=50 broad-universe signal cell

prevalence.note: prevalence declines train (18.0%) -> eval (6.4%) -> test (5.7%); the +30%/50d up-move got rarer over the sample window. Drift caps calibrated-probability quality while leaving ranking intact.

loop.note: default (algorithmic-fallback) FS+HP callback pruned the 279-feature pool to 39 at iteration 0; best checkpoint is iteration 1 with those 39 features. HP unchanged from default (depth 6, lr 0.05, Bayesian bootstrap, Ordered boosting, l2 3.0, 1000 trees, early-stop 75).

calibration.note: native CatBoost probs miscalibrated (|z|=12.38, p~0) -> isotonic layer applied.

r_precision_weighted.formula: sum(positives_caught) / sum(R(d)); R(d) = positives that day

verdict.compound_rule: AUC ~0.72 (well outside [0.45,0.55] null band) AND weighted R-precision lift 3.2-4.4x base rate -> strong signal cell, not null.
verdict.universe_breadth_read: Weighted R-precision lift here (eval 4.36x, test 3.17x) exceeds the nifty50 _147 H=25 cell's ~2.0-2.2x, consistent with the spec's thesis that the ~376-name cross-section gives F14 cross-sectional rank/z features a deeper distribution. n=1 cell; one data point, not a controlled universe-size ablation.
verdict.caveat: Test-split Brier (0.0554) underperforms the base-rate constant (0.0534) by -0.0020 despite AUC 0.715 and strong per-day P@k/R-precision. This is a calibration-on-drifted-prevalence artifact: isotonic was fit on val (~higher prevalence) and the model over-predicts on the low-prevalence (5.7%) test window, hurting Brier even though RANKING is preserved. The trading rule consumes ranking (R-precision / P@k), which is strong; the limitation is calibrated-probability accuracy under prevalence drift, not discrimination.

context.h25_cross_market_corpus: memo _138 (nasdaq100/sp500/nifty50/nifty100 H=25 +10%/dd5%) had weighted R-precision lifts ~1.5-2x. This H=50 +30% broad-universe cell sits materially above that band.
context.nifty50_h25_cell: memo _147 (nifty50 +10%/25d/dd5%) weighted R-precision lift ~2.0-2.2x; same prevalence-drift ceiling story (train 28% -> eval 14%).
